notes.title: The new game Scarlet Wolf is now available!
notes.content:
Are you ready to step through that very door?


Beyond it lie endless corridors, traps, and a darkness that never sleeps.

Here your fears take shape, and every decision brings you closer either to salvation… or to demise.



Alex is reliving the same nightmare over and over. To break free, he turns to a psychologist for help—and together they dive into grim secrets of the past, where monsters aren’t always the main threat.


💀 In the game you’ll find:
A rich atmosphere of horror and hopelessness

Unique monsters and character design

Realistic sounds and an original soundtrack

A tense storyline with psychological themes

Traps, escapes, and choices that decide your fate
[hr][/hr]🔗 Dive into the darkness now!

notes.title: Update of World End Echo
notes.content:
Greetings to all fans of our visual novel!

We are excited to announce an update to our game that brings numerous improvements, making your gaming experience even more engaging and thrilling.

What's new in the update?

Localization in 9 new languages

We are pleased to inform you that our game is now available in nine new languages: Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Italian, and Ukrainian. This will allow even more players to enjoy our story.

Updated text

We have expanded the game's textual elements by adding new dialogues to immerse you deeper into the storyline. Expect new unexpected twists that reveal additional aspects of the story and characters, deepening your emotional connection with the game. We hope that the new scenes and lines will give you a fresh perspective on the familiar characters.

UI Enhancements

We've added new animations and effects to make the interface even more interactive and visually appealing. Navigation through the menus and interaction with interface elements is now smoother, making the gameplay experience more comfortable and immersive.

Bug fixes

We've fixed known bugs, especially those related to the "match-three" mode. Now you can enjoy the game without technical issues and obstacles!

Thank you for your support and feedback, which helps us improve the game. Join the discussion in our community and share your thoughts on the new update. Your opinion is very important to us!

If you have any additional questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave comments or contact us directly.

Enjoy the game and see you in the post-apocalyptic world!
